entities.summary: Vincenzo Brunacci was an Italian mathematician born in Florence. He was professor of Matematica sublime in Pavia. He transmitted Lagrange's ideas to his pupils, including Ottaviano Fabrizio Mossotti, Antonio Bordoni and Gabrio Piola.
